unit.why: A single narrative about the Maggid of Kozienice protecting a young Hasid from sin by appearing in his dream, as related by the tzaddik of Parysów.

stories.start_quote: ואגב אכתוב מעשה א׳ הנודע ומפורסם
stories.end_quote: ממורו ז״ל, והיה הדבר הזה לפלא
stories.summary_en: At a Friday-night meal in Kozienice the Maggid speaks at length about a young Hasid from Parysów and says he must guard the young men even at home. His disciple, the tzaddik of Parysów, questions the young man. The man tells him that the Maggid twice appeared in his dream on his wife's immersion night and warned him, so he held back until she became niddah. The disciple marvels at his master's power.
